10.2.5.20.2 DcmDspSecurityRow [ECUC_Dcm_00759] Definition of EcucParamConfContainerDef DcmDspSecurity Row ⌈ Container Name DcmDspSecurityRow Parent Container DcmDspSecurity Description Definition of a single Row of configuration for security level configuration (per security level) The name of this container is used to define the name of the R-Port through which the DCM accesses the interface SecurityAccess_{SecurityLevel}. The R-Port is named SecurityAccess_{SecurityLevel} where {SecurityLevel} is the name of the container DcmDspSecurityRow. If there is no reference, no check of security level shall be done.
